steps.text: 1. The Tourist opens the "Ratings" section on the tour details and taps the "Report" button (flag icon) on another person's comment.

2. The client opens the "Report a violating rating" dialog; the Actor picks a reason (Spam/Advertising, Hate speech/Insults, False information/Off-topic, Other) and enters an extra description (optional, at most 500 characters).
3. The Actor taps "Send report"; the client validates it and calls the report API.
4. The server checks: signed in, public tour, the rating is still visible, not reporting one's own rating, has not reported this rating before; valid? E1–E4.

exceptions.text: E1. Not signed in → "Please sign in to report a violation" and go to sign-in (UC#01) (401).
E2. Reporting one's own rating → the button is hidden in the UI; calling the API directly returns 400.
E3. This rating was already reported (any status) → 409, the dialog shows "You have already reported this rating".
E4. The tour is not public, the rating was deleted or removed, or the reportId does not exist → 404.

steps.text: 5. The server stores the report in tour_rating_reports (PENDING); if the total number of PENDING reports reaches the threshold N ≥ 3, it sets is_flagged = true automatically (201).
6. The client closes the modal and shows "Your report has been sent and is waiting for an administrator to review it."

7. The Admin opens the "Rating complaints" page (/admin/reports/ratings); the system checks the Admin role and loads the status=pending queue (flagged first, then author complaints, then newest)? A2, E5.

exceptions.text: E5. The account does not have the Admin role → 403; no token → 401.

steps.text: 8. The Admin chooses "Remove rating" or "Dismiss report", enters a handling note (optional) in the confirmation dialog and taps "Confirm".
9. The client calls the report handling API with the action (REMOVE_RATING or DISMISS) and the handling note.

10. The server handles it in one transaction: every PENDING report of the rating changes status; DISMISS → DISMISSED and is_flagged = false; REMOVE_RATING → RESOLVED, sets is_hidden = true and recomputes average_rating and rating_count with atomic SQL (only once).
11. The client shows "Report handled successfully" and refreshes the queue.

steps: A1.1. The tour author (Author) opens the "Ratings" section on their own tour details and taps the "Complain" button on a comment; the client opens the "Rating complaint" dialog.
A1.2. The Author picks a reason and enters a detailed explanation (optional); the server stores reporter_role = 'AUTHOR' and the Admin queue shows the "Complaint from the Author" label.
A2.1. The Admin switches between the "Pending", "Removed" and "Dismissed" tabs on /admin/reports/ratings to look up handled reports.
